baseline.method: Original PowdR BFGS/Rwp, known20wt% internal standard

definitions.composition_rmse: RMS wt% error over six unknown phases, separately for each mixture; actual weighed truth
definitions.fitted_nrmse: RMS modeled-count difference / dynamic range of independent native fitted profile, per mixture
definitions.shift_error: Absolute degrees relative to native correlation registration
definitions.fraction_consistency: Relative L2 difference of submitted profile and model implied by submitted fractions/shifts, after one positive nuisance intensity scale is fitted to submitted profile; no alignment of outputs

reference_policy: Actual weighed ground_truth is authoritative for composition only. Method baseline supplies shifts/fitted because no independently measured truth exists for these quantities.
